The studio guide for [`mascot_mood()`](../reference/mascot_mood.html). The same page is read in the mascot studio.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(mascot)
guide <- system.file("examples", "studio", "guide", package = "mascot")
source(file.path(guide, "guide-helpers.R"))
```

```{r child = file.path(guide, "mascot_mood.Rmd")}
```
